proposal.hypothesis: Processing two rows per 256-thread threadgroup shares each parameter float4 across both rows, keeps x values in registers, and uses a single threadgroup barrier with redundant per-thread reduction, reducing parameter traffic and synchronization versus one row per threadgroup.

One threadgroup per row holding four float4 values per thread in registers enables a single input pass; SIMD plus shared-memory reduction then applies one rsqrt and vectorized weights, minimizing memory traffic and barriers.
